note: The Islamic State's national spirits (gameplay values). Starting ones are added by the spawn event of January 2014 in data/events/conflicts.json.

spirits.name: An overstretched administration
spirits.description: Services and offices fall behind as the territory grows faster than the administration.

spirits.name: A proto-state
spirits.description: Councils, offices and courts run the towns the group holds.

spirits.name: War revenue
spirits.description: Oil sales, levies and seized assets pay for the group.

spirits.name: The dinar
spirits.description: The group issues its own coinage, the dinar, alongside the currencies already in use.

spirits.name: Foreign recruits
spirits.description: Recruits from abroad join the group's forces.

spirits.name: Besieged cities
spirits.description: The cities are surrounded and supply runs short.

spirits.name: An entrenched state
spirits.description: The administration has outlasted the offensives against it and runs the territory as a state.

spirits.name: Insurgency
spirits.description: Small cells in the desert and the countryside replace the fixed front lines.

spirits.name: Desert networks
spirits.description: Hideouts and supply routes across the desert between Iraq and Syria.
